scenes.caption: Part 1 · Sunset Run Club (sports)

scenes.title: Create room, clear edge
scenes.caption: Room settings never hide under the Create button.
scenes.highlight: Hairline and gap above Create room, AI switch just above it
scenes.check: ✓ AI switch fully visible; gap separates it from Create (fix i)

scenes.title: Same edge in dark
scenes.caption: Same clear edge in dark mode.
scenes.highlight: Separator line above Create room in dark mode
scenes.check: ✓ Separator visible in dark mode (fix i)

scenes.title: Invite code
scenes.caption: Start a temporary room in seconds.
scenes.highlight: 5-digit code and QR
scenes.check: ✓ Room created with a 5-digit code

scenes.title: Friends join
scenes.caption: Friends join by code or QR, no sign-up.
scenes.highlight: Each phone lands in the chat
scenes.check: ✓ 4 guests joined by code

scenes.title: Target pace prefill

scenes.title: Arrived

scenes.highlight: "X arrived" notices in the chat
scenes.check: ✓ 4 arrival notices

scenes.title: Arrival count
scenes.highlight: "5 people · 4 arrived" on Info
scenes.check: ✓ 5 people · 4 arrived

scenes.title: Arrivals survive restart
scenes.caption: Arrivals count for the meetup, not each activity.
scenes.highlight: Info count after End → Start activity
scenes.check: ✓ Still 4 arrived after End → Start activity (fix c)

scenes.title: Pace groups
scenes.caption: Pace cues keep the group together.
scenes.highlight: Map groups and Dani's lead-group cue
scenes.check: ✓ Lead group 150 m ahead → Dani caught up

scenes.title: Emergency
scenes.caption: Emergency reaches everyone at once.
scenes.highlight: Red Emergency banner, then "Seen by Mina"
scenes.check: ✓ Seen by Mina → resolved

scenes.caption: Ask Qrewing knows where the group is.

scenes.check: ✓ Says you are moving; names lead group Mina and Jun (fixes b, h)

scenes.title: Ask: emergency history
scenes.caption: It remembers what happened in the room.
scenes.highlight: Answer naming Leo's Emergency
scenes.check: ✓ Names Leo's Emergency and that it was resolved (fix a)

scenes.caption: A recap when the room ends; data is deleted after.
scenes.highlight: Recap pace lines and the Emergency line
scenes.check: ✓ Recap includes pace and the Emergency (fix a)
